desc: Derive the invariant: smoke positions at t+0.5 equal {P_t - P_k : k in B_t}; generation rule reduces to checking whether -offset_t is already in the stored set.
Design incremental simulation: keep stored keys fixed, track global offset (or_, oc); inserts and queries use offset compensation — O(N) total.
Birth rule: after wind update at time t, insert key (-or_, -oc) if not present (covers initial t=0 smoke via initial set {(0,0)}).
Query rule: output 1 iff (R - or_, C - oc) in set, evaluated after the generation step (matches t+0.5 semantics).
Implement full solution with fast I/O, direction mapping (N:(-1,0), S:(1,0), W:(0,-1), E:(0,1)), and verify against sample 1 by hand-simulation (output 001010 ✓).
